mapper.select: SELECT TR_NO, BANK_CODE, BRANCH_CODE, EMP_NO, TR_CODE, TR_DATE, TR_TIME, ACCT_NO, CUST_NM, AMOUNT, BALANCE, RES_CODE, RES_MSG FROM TB_TR_HIST WHERE TR_NO = #{trNo}
SELECT TR_NO, BANK_CODE, BRANCH_CODE, EMP_NO, TR_CODE, TR_DATE, TR_TIME, ACCT_NO, CUST_NM, AMOUNT, BALANCE, RES_CODE, RES_MSG FROM TB_TR_HIST WHERE ACCT_NO = #{acctNo} ORDER BY REG_DTM DESC

SELECT TR_NO, TR_CODE, TR_DATE, TR_TIME, ACCT_NO, AMOUNT, BALANCE FROM TB_TR_HIST WHERE ACCT_NO = #{acctNo} AND TR_DATE BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} AND RES_CODE = '0000' ORDER BY TR_DATE DESC, TR_TIME DESC
